fusions.name: Snarled Tight
fusions.desc: Whips a tangle of strands around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Pulled by the Roots
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Combs hard through the target, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Woven Hedge
fusions.desc: Weaves a hedge of strands 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Tangle Guard
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
